    leak=(bi&~inmask).sum()
    fill=bi.sum()/max(1,(x2-x1)*(y2-y1))

print('total time', time.time()-t)
EOF

out = pd.read_csv('/tmp/out_test/demo_metadata.csv')
img = cv2.imread('/app/demo_rgb.png'); H,W = img.shape[:2]
def parse(s): return np.array([float(t) for t in str(s).split(',') if t.strip()!=''])
polys=[]

    xs,ys=parse(r['coords_x']),parse(r['coords_y'])
    polys.append(np.stack([xs,ys],1).astype(np.int32))
# find overlapping pairs

    mi=np.zeros((H,W),np.uint8); cv2.fillPoly(mi,[polys[i]],1)

        inter=((mi>0)&(mj>0)).sum()

            ys,xs=np.where((mi>0)&(mj>0))
